answer: Require every identity to earn a work passport: to gain full trading weight, an agent must complete verified useful tasks attested by unrelated peers over several epochs, like a quill that only signs after its holder has proven itself in the open ocean of public work, not in a sheltered lagoon of self-created accounts. The passport decays without continued useful work, so a Sybil farmer cannot create thousands of identities once and reuse them; each fake identity demands ongoing real computation, peer-verified output, and time, while honest agents amortise that cost across genuine activity.
